report:
Right fallopian tube, salpingotomy

Received in formalin are fragments of haemorrhagic tissue measuring 3 x 2 x 1 cm in aggregate. The fragments comprise blood clot and villous material. No foetal parts are grossly identified. All embedded in 2 blocks.

(1)&(2) Haemorrhagic tissue.

The sections show chorionic villi and blood clot. There is no evidence of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia or other malignancies.

Right FALLOPIAN TUBE, salpingotomy - PRODUCTS OF GESTATION, consistent with ECTOPIC TUBAL PREGNANCY

Following salpingotomy, trophoblast may persist in the tube; serial serum hCG measurement until a negative result is obtained is recommended.
